task.name: ZE 49 is happening again
task.notes: Root cause: scenes::Append (runtime prefab spawn) passed the prefab's OWN object ids to RestoreReferences without remapping. The bullet's "export rigidbody rb" self-reference then pointed at a stale id, so BoundScript's reference binding threw "Scene object no longer exists" out of spawn() and faulted the calling script - freezing the player while physics kept running (same class as ZE-49). Fix: Append now remaps every script objectReference through its id remap table in a second pass (references that leave the prefab are dropped). EditorShell::SpawnPrefab also no longer rethrows a spawned script's Prepare failure - it reports it to the status bar and leaves that one behavior inert instead of faulting the spawner. New SceneTests regression spawns a prefab whose script self-references its rigidbody and asserts the stored reference is the live id, not the prefab id. The "bullet at 0,0,0" was a downstream symptom of shoot() aborting before the position line; with the fault gone the position assignment runs (not verifiable here without a running game - reopen if it persists). Full ctest 29/29.

task.name: ScriptIntegrationEditor test no longer selects on mouse-down
task.prompt: The ScriptEditorIntegration suite (zEngineAssetTests --scripts, ctest "ScriptEditorIntegration") fails at "Save/reload lost Inspector override". Cause: commit d8821c8 moved scene-tree selection from WM_LBUTTONDOWN to WM_LBUTTONUP (release-time selection, ZE-44) and updated most click tests, but ScriptIntegrationEditorTests in tests/AssetTests.cpp still sends only WM_LBUTTONDOWN at (50,140) to re-select the scripted cube. With no WM_LBUTTONUP the selection never changes, so the Inspector stays bound to the later empty GameObject (whose script keeps the default speed=2 instead of the overridden 6). Reproduce: build builds/test, run ctest -C Debug -R ScriptEditorIntegration.

task.notes: Fixed in commit f2d31c6. ScriptIntegrationEditorTests re-selected the scripted cube with a bare WM_LBUTTONDOWN; selection now commits on WM_LBUTTONUP (ZE-44). Added the matching release event at (50,140). Full ctest suite green 27/27.

task.name: look for bugs or optimizations
task.prompt: go through the entire code base and look for any optimizations (bother for engine and game performance) speed up where possible, fix any potential bugs you see, and in general improve the code base
task.notes: Targeted optimization pass over the per-frame hot path. Main win: ObjectStore::Find was a linear O(n) scan and is called many times per frame from PhysicsWorld::Step (per body, plus recursive GlobalPose parent walks), ScriptHost transform synchronization (per proxy, per script), BuildSceneFrame/ParentMatrix, and scene lookups - giving O(n^2) behaviour as scenes grow. Added an ID->GameObject* hash index (std::unordered_map) maintained by Restore/Remove/move-assignment; pointers are stable because GameObjects are heap-owned by unique_ptr, so the index survives vector growth and store moves. Find is now O(1). Deeper items were assessed and deliberately deferred as high risk relative to reward: script VM is a string-keyed tree-walker (bytecode/interned-locals rewrite), GameObject::GetBehavior uses dynamic_cast in a loop (needs a type-tag system), BehaviorLifecycle::Ordered shuffles+sorts 3x/frame (the shuffle is intentional anti-order-dependence). Verified: rebuilt and ran CoreTests, SceneTests, ScriptHostTests, PhysicsTests, LifecycleTests, ScriptEditorTests, and every zEngineAssetTests suite (objects, scenes, hierarchy, prefabs, editor, text, folders) - all pass.
